abstract: OBJECTIVE: The present study aims to discuss the clinical features, treatment, and prognosis of fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas (SCTs) to improve the standard of diagnosis and treatment. METHODS: The clinical data of 15 pregnant females with fetal SCT, admitted to Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital from January 2013 to January 2020, were retrospectively analyzed with respect to clinical characteristics, imaging features, complications, treatment options, and pregnancy outcomes. RESULTS: The 15 cases of fetal SCT were all detected by color ultrasonography. There were two cases of cystic tumors and 13 cases of solid cystic tumors. In terms of tumor blood supply, there was one case without blood flow signal, eight cases with little blood flow signal, and six cases with abundant blood flow. At the time of delivery, there were two cases with a tumor diameter less than 5 cm, five cases with a diameter of 5-10 cm, and eight cases with a diameter of more than 10 cm. In terms of tumor shape and location, there were two cases of type I, ten cases of type II, and three cases of type III. There were six cases with an increased fetal heart to chest ratio, four cases of fetal edema, three cases of placental edema, four cases of excessive amniotic fluid, one case of insufficient amniotic fluid, three cases of fetal distress, one case of stillbirth, two cases of gestational diabetes mellitus, two cases of mirror syndrome, and two cases of postpartum hemorrhage. According to the pathological diagnosis, there were seven cases of mature teratoma, seven cases of immature teratoma, and one case of mixed germ cell tumor. There were six cases of induced delivery, nine cases of cesarean section, one case of premature birth, and two cases of mild neonatal asphyxia. CONCLUSION: Fetal SCT was generally diagnosed by prenatal ultrasonography. The tumor blood supply, growth rate, size, nature of the tumor, clinical type, pathology, and maternal-fetal complications are all closely correlated with the prognosis. The timing and manner of the termination of pregnancy should be determined on the basis of the pregnant female, the fetus, and the tumor.
abstract_ja: 目的：本研究の目的は、胎児仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)の臨床的特徴、治療、予後について検討し、診断および治療の水準を向上させることである。方法：2013年1月から2020年1月に福建省母子保健院で胎児SCTと診断された妊婦15例の臨床データを後方視的に解析し、臨床的特徴、画像所見、合併症、治療選択、妊娠転帰について検討した。結果：胎児SCT 15例はすべてカラー超音波検査で検出された。嚢胞性腫瘍が2例、充実嚢胞性腫瘍が13例であった。腫瘍の血流については、血流信号を認めなかったものが1例、血流信号がわずかなものが8例、血流が豊富なものが6例であった。分娩時点の腫瘍径は、5cm未満が2例、5～10cmが5例、10cmを超えるものが8例であった。腫瘍の形状と部位については、I型が2例、II型が10例、III型が3例であった。胎児心胸比の増大が6例、胎児浮腫が4例、胎盤浮腫が3例、羊水過多が4例、羊水過少が1例、胎児機能不全が3例、死産が1例、妊娠糖尿病が2例、ミラー症候群が2例、産後出血が2例に認められた。病理学的診断では、成熟奇形腫が7例、未熟奇形腫が7例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍が1例であった。分娩方法は、誘発分娩が6例、帝王切開が9例、早産が1例、軽度の新生児仮死が2例であった。結論：胎児SCTは一般的に出生前超音波検査で診断される。腫瘍の血流供給、増殖速度、大きさ、腫瘍の性状、臨床型、病理学的所見、および母体・胎児の合併症は、いずれも予後と密接に関連している。妊娠中絶の時期と方法は、妊婦、胎児、腫瘍の状態に基づいて決定すべきである。
